mechanism_comment: Acipimox is a hypolipidemic agent. It has special application for the treatment of hyperlipidemia in non-insulin-dependent diabetic patients. Acipimox acts on the niacin receptor 1, inhibiting the enzyme triglyceride lipase. This reduces the concentration of fatty acids in the blood plasma and their inflow into the liver. Consequently, VLDL cholesterol production in the liver is reduced, which leads indirectly to a reduction in LDL and increase in HDL cholesterol (Wikipedia).
